TrickWork's desktop installer follows PommelPorter 1.1.5.

## 🐛 Fixed

- Uninstalling the desktop app on Windows leaves nothing behind, and the installer window shows TrickWork's icon on Linux. The installer follows [PommelPorter 1.1.5](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/pommelporter/releases/tag/v1.1.5), and a release with an older PommelPorter stops before it builds.
